in_marathi.name: Shalin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Shining Pearls
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shalin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shalin is of Sanskrit origin, meaning 'Mountain of Shining Pearls'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shaila' meaning mountain and 'Ankusha' meaning pearl. This name is often given to a child born during the night of the new moon and is believed to bring peace and calmness to the family.
